trust.heading: Established expertise since 2000
trust.body: Al Oun was founded in Kuwait in 2000 and provides a broad range of legal services to individuals, companies, business owners and investors — both locally and internationally. Our work rests on steady principles: transparency, confidentiality and security, credibility, professionalism, integrity, commitment and excellence.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This document explains how Al Oun handles data submitted through this website. The final approved text will be published after review by the firm's legal counsel.
privacy.pending: Final legal content is being prepared and approved by the firm.

sections.b: We collect data you voluntarily provide through the consultation request form (name, contact method, and an optional note). We do not request sensitive case details through the website.
Your data is used only to respond to your request and route you appropriately. It is not shared with third parties for marketing.
We follow technical and organizational measures to limit unauthorized access to submitted data.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data through the firm's official channels.
For any privacy inquiry, contact the firm through the published contact details.

terms.heading: Terms & Disclaimer
terms.intro: These terms govern use of the Al Oun website. The final approved text will be published after review by the firm's legal counsel.
